The '''mercuryfish''' was a variety of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] to members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Trey Duna]], the Human [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], often ate grilled fillets of mercuryfish at one of the planet's finest [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mercuryfish was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
